name: volcanic
description: A visual, accessible editor for Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian, rendered by Pele.

scripts.build: node scripts/theme-css.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.harness: node scripts/theme-css.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs harness && node dev/serve.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
